quote.text: Where is the man who sets some value on his time, who knows the worth of a day and who realizes that he is dying every instant? While we put things off until tomorrow, life slips away. Nothing is ours, Lucilles, save only our time. And yet we let the first comer deprive us of our sole and fleeting fortune.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that every moment spent with your children is irreplaceable; cherish present interactions, teaching them the value of time through your own mindful example.
    • Embrace the urgency of nurturing their growth today rather than postponing guidance or affection, for the fleeting nature of time shapes the fabric of their future character.
  • Leadership
    • Understand that true leadership is measured by an awareness of time’s passing; apply deliberate action in decisions and inspire your team to seize opportunities without delay.
    • Practice setting clear goals and valuing every moment, ensuring that each decision is purposeful, aligning with the broader vision while remaining mindful of life’s brevity.
  • Product Management
    • Prioritize efficiently in each sprint and product iteration, understanding that time is your most precious resource, essential to delivering value and nurturing innovation.
    • Balance vision with urgency; focus on actions that yield immediate impact while maintaining a strategic overview, ensuring that no opportunity for progress is wasted.
